# CULTURE
T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_culture = {
	has_variable_list = kCAFG_province_cultures
    is_target_in_variable_list = {
        name = kCAFG_province_cultures
        target = $CULTURE$
    }
}

T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_any_culture = {
	has_variable_list = kCAFG_province_cultures
    variable_list_size = {
        name = kCAFG_province_cultures
        value > 0
    }
}

# VALUE
T_kCAFG_province_cultures_count_at_least = {
	has_variable_list = kCAFG_province_cultures
    variable_list_size = {
        name = kCAFG_province_cultures
        value >= $VALUE$
    }
}

# Only culture in province
# CULTURE
T_kCAFG_province_only_culture = {
    variable_list_size = {
        name = kCAFG_province_cultures
        value = 1
    }
    is_target_in_variable_list = {
        name = kCAFG_province_cultures
        target = $CULTURE$
    }
}
